research_progress.source_confidence_semantics: Heuristic research-source confidence only: direct official HM Land Registry, MHCLG and GOV.UK verification; 2026 currentness where available; title-plan/general-boundary, registration status, overriding interests, notices/restrictions, lease/easement, unregistered-land, alteration/rectification and compulsory-purchase stage separation. Not parcel-level accuracy.

verification.method: Direct official-web verification plus repository duplicate searches

official_sources.name: HM Land Registry title plan PG40 supplement 5
official_sources.fact: Updated 13 July 2026; title plans support the register and normally show general extent.
official_sources.gate: Red edging is not an exact legal boundary or development-clearance proof.

official_sources.name: HM Land Registry boundaries PG40 supplement 3
official_sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; HMLR explains general, physical and determined boundaries.
official_sources.gate: A mapped feature is not the exact legal boundary without the relevant evidence.

official_sources.name: Boundary agreements and determined boundaries PG40 supplement 4
official_sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; a recorded boundary agreement can still leave a general boundary unless determined.
official_sources.gate: Boundary agreement is not the same as a determined exact boundary.

official_sources.name: How to read a title plan
official_sources.fact: HMLR says plans must be read with the register and may reference easements/covenants.
official_sources.gate: No coloured reference does not prove no easement or covenant.

official_sources.name: How to read a title register
official_sources.fact: The register can show ownership, class, restrictions, charges, rights and covenants.
official_sources.gate: Entries require exact wording/date review; category presence is not a development conclusion.

official_sources.name: Search the land and property register
official_sources.fact: GOV.UK distinguishes online and official copies and notes title plans show general boundaries.
official_sources.gate: Address search is not exhaustive proof of every title affecting land.

official_sources.name: Search the index map service
official_sources.fact: SIM can identify title numbers affecting an area and confirm unregistered status.
official_sources.gate: An address-search miss is not proof of unregistered land.

official_sources.name: Practice guide 10 official search of the index map
official_sources.fact: Updated 20 July 2026; PG10 covers index-map search, plans and certificates.
official_sources.gate: SIM identifies registration records, not planning permission or exact ownership rights.

official_sources.name: HM Land Registry portal official copies
official_sources.fact: HMLR explains official copies and warns property-detail searches may miss other titles.
official_sources.gate: One matched title is not exhaustive where SIM is needed.

official_sources.name: HM Land Registry guaranteed queries and services
official_sources.fact: HMLR lists guaranteed queries including SIM and official copies.
official_sources.gate: Guaranteed copy does not convert general boundaries to exact surveyed boundaries.

official_sources.name: Get a copy of the deeds
official_sources.fact: HMLR may hold scanned filed deeds but does not keep original paper deeds.
official_sources.gate: No filed copy does not prove no historic rights or covenants.

official_sources.name: HM Land Registry historical copies portal
official_sources.fact: Historical register/title-plan editions can be requested for specified dates.
official_sources.gate: Historical state is not current ownership, interests or geometry.

official_sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data
official_sources.fact: Updated 8 July 2026; INSPIRE is an open subset showing freehold registered-property locations.
official_sources.gate: INSPIRE is not a full title plan and is not exact legal-boundary evidence.

official_sources.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE guidance
official_sources.fact: HMLR describes INSPIRE polygons as a subset of Index Polygons for freehold property.
official_sources.gate: Open geometry is discovery data, not ownership/easement/restriction proof.

official_sources.name: Finding information held by HM Land Registry
official_sources.fact: Published 23 July 2025; HMLR states online ownership search covers registered property only.
official_sources.gate: No online result is not proof of ownerless land.

official_sources.name: First registrations PG1
official_sources.fact: Updated 15 December 2025; PG1 covers first registration and title evidence.
official_sources.gate: Unregistered is not ownerless and does not mean no rights/covenants.

official_sources.name: Lost or destroyed deeds PG2
official_sources.fact: Updated 20 July 2026; PG2 requires evidence and may result in possessory title where evidence is incomplete.
official_sources.gate: Lost deeds or possessory title are not clean-title proof.

official_sources.name: Adverse possession of registered land PG4
official_sources.fact: Updated 2 February 2026; PG4 covers applications, notices and objections.
official_sources.gate: Possession/application is not ownership until registration outcome is verified.

official_sources.name: Adverse possession of unregistered or pre-2003 land PG5
official_sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; PG5 covers unregistered and specified pre-2003 claims.
official_sources.gate: Occupation history is not registered ownership without the applicable outcome.

official_sources.name: Upgrading the class of title PG42
official_sources.fact: PG42 explains absolute, possessory, qualified and good leasehold title.
official_sources.gate: Registered ownership does not mean identical title quality.

official_sources.name: Overriding interests PG15
official_sources.fact: PG15 explains interests that can bind registered land without appearing in the register.
official_sources.gate: A clean-looking register is not proof of no overriding interests.

official_sources.name: Notices restrictions and third-party interests PG19
official_sources.fact: Updated 8 June 2026; PG19 covers notices/restrictions and says an entry does not guarantee the underlying interest's validity.
official_sources.gate: Exact entry, beneficiary and compliance requirement must be checked.

official_sources.name: Leases when to register PG25
official_sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; PG25 covers registration and noting of leases.
official_sources.gate: Freehold discovery does not prove absence of leasehold interests.

official_sources.name: Easements PG62
official_sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; PG62 covers registration of easements and prescriptive-easement requirements.
official_sources.gate: Easement data requires exact benefitting/burdened land and terms.

official_sources.name: Prescribed clauses leases PG64
official_sources.fact: PG64 explains lease easements may require prescribed-clause references or separate registration applications.
official_sources.gate: A derived lease summary cannot prove absence of easements.

official_sources.name: Land Charges and Agricultural Credits PG63
official_sources.fact: Updated 13 April 2026; PG63 covers Land Charges for unregistered land and agricultural credits.
official_sources.gate: Registered-title search does not replace Land Charges checks for unregistered land.

official_sources.name: Amending deeds affecting registered land PG68
official_sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; PG68 covers deeds correcting earlier disposition documents.
official_sources.gate: Amended deed/application is not a changed register until completion.

official_sources.name: Removing land from a title plan PG77
official_sources.fact: Updated 1 June 2026; PG77 covers applications to remove land from title plans.
official_sources.gate: Alteration application is not an already-corrected title extent.

official_sources.name: Alteration PG83
official_sources.fact: PG83 explains defined routes to alter the register under Schedule 4.
official_sources.gate: Current register is authoritative for its state but live alteration proceedings can matter.

official_sources.name: Rectification and indemnity PG39
official_sources.fact: PG39 distinguishes register mistakes from deed mistakes and explains rectification.
official_sources.gate: An alleged mistake is not corrected until the legal/registration outcome is verified.

official_sources.name: Acquisition by general vesting declaration PG54
official_sources.fact: Updated 16 March 2026 for 2025 Act changes; PG54 covers registration after GVD vesting of land or rights.
official_sources.gate: CPO/proposed GVD is not proof title or rights have vested.

official_sources.name: Compulsory purchase process guidance
official_sources.fact: Updated 17 June 2026; guidance separates power, justification, making, confirmation, implementation and compensation.
official_sources.gate: CPO proposal/making is not acquisition; confirmation and implementation must be distinguished.

official_sources.name: Compulsory purchase orders register of decisions
official_sources.fact: Updated 28 April 2026; register records confirmation decisions for housing/planning/regeneration CPOs.
official_sources.gate: Decision index still requires exact order, map, modifications and implementation checks.

official_sources.name: Compulsory purchase guide 1 procedure
official_sources.fact: Guide 1 separates preparation, objections, decision, possession/acquisition and compensation.
official_sources.gate: Confirmation must not be collapsed into current possession/ownership.

official_sources.name: Compulsory purchase guide 2 business compensation
official_sources.fact: Guide 2 covers compensation for business owners and occupiers.
official_sources.gate: Compensation eligibility/claim is not proof of title vesting or deliverability.

official_sources.name: Compulsory purchase guide 3 agricultural compensation
official_sources.fact: Guide 3 covers agricultural compensation including land value, disturbance and severance.
official_sources.gate: Compensation heads are not proxy evidence for acquisition status or development value.

official_sources.name: Compulsory purchase guide 4 residential compensation
official_sources.fact: Guide 4 covers compensation for residential owners and occupiers.
official_sources.gate: Compensation rights do not prove confirmed/implemented acquisition.

official_sources.name: Upper Tribunal land compensation procedure T616
official_sources.fact: Updated 13 July 2026; T616 covers tribunal procedure for compulsory-purchase and land-compensation references.
official_sources.gate: Tribunal stage is not final compensation, title transfer or development status.

official_sources.name: Purchase notices
official_sources.fact: A purchase notice does not require purchase unless accepted, confirmed or deemed confirmed under the statutory route.
official_sources.gate: Serving a purchase notice is not an acquisition or guaranteed purchase.

official_sources.name: The Crichel Down Rules
official_sources.fact: The non-statutory rules concern offer-back of qualifying surplus land acquired by or under threat of compulsion.
official_sources.gate: Possible rule applicability is not proof land is surplus or repurchase completed.
